note: Checked main e305bdb: hooks/decision_watch.py's changed_this_turn gives no answer when the folder is not a git work tree, and test case_not_a_repo pins that on purpose. A notice that repeats every turn teaches you to scroll past it. Ruling, Oct 27 23:48 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 8, a, accepted pick): say it once per session in plain words, then stay quiet.
